meta.name: NeXify Automation Control Register
meta.purpose: Zentrales Register aller relevanten Automationen, Trigger, Hooks, Cron-Jobs und Governance-Kontrollen im Repository.

automations.name: Pre-commit Validation Pipeline
automations.gate: Hard gate before local commit; blocks secrets, invalid YAML/JSON, formatting and Python issues.
automations.healthcheck: pre-commit run --all-files
automations.rollback: Adjust hook config or temporarily remove local installation after documented approval.
automations.abort: Abort commit on any hook failure or detected secret.

automations.name: Pre-push Boundary Enforcement
automations.gate: Tenant- and secret-boundary enforcement before remote write.
automations.healthcheck: Manual hook installation and push simulation on managed environments.
automations.rollback: Disable hook only with documented exception and compensating CI controls.
automations.abort: Abort push when customer, tenant or secret boundary checks fail.

automations.name: GitHub Test Suite
automations.gate: Primary CI gate for lint, tests, security checks and Docker build validation.
automations.healthcheck: GitHub Actions workflow status; job-level success and weekly schedule execution.
automations.rollback: Revert failing workflow changes or rerun from last known good commit.
automations.abort: Abort on invalid config, mandatory gate failure or repeated scheduled failures.

automations.name: GitHub Build and GHCR Publish
automations.gate: Builds and optionally publishes Docker images for core services.
automations.healthcheck: Successful image build matrix and GHCR publish status.
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions logs, GHCR image tags
automations.rollback: Revert image-building changes; redeploy using previous image tags.
automations.abort: Abort on buildx/docker failures, invalid Docker context, or registry auth issues.

automations.name: GitHub VPS Deployment
automations.gate: Production deploy path with SSH, health checks and governance post-checks.
automations.healthcheck: SSH deploy step, localhost service checks, infra/scripts/health-check.sh
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions logs + governance evidence under docs/governance/08_evidence/
automations.rollback: Redeploy previous known good revision on VPS after diagnosis.
automations.abort: Abort on missing deploy secrets, failed critical checks, or unrecoverable container start errors.

automations.name: GitHub VPS Deployment
automations.gate: Production website deploy with design-system integrity gate.
automations.healthcheck: Design-system validation + /api/health post-deploy check
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions logs + VPS deployment status
automations.rollback: Redeploy previous VPS version or revert commit.
automations.abort: Abort on missing VPS secrets, design-system mismatch, or failing deployment command.

automations.name: GitHub Mirror to GitLab
automations.gate: Complete repository mirror to VPS GitLab with mandatory HTTPS credentials.
automations.healthcheck: Successful mirror push result.
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions logs, GitLab mirrored refs
automations.rollback: Remove mirrored ref or re-push corrected refs from GitHub.
automations.abort: Abort on missing credentials, auth failure, invalid mirror URL, or repository mismatch.

automations.name: GitHub Secret Scan
automations.gate: Repository-level secret leak detection.
automations.healthcheck: Gitleaks action success.
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions logs, security workflow history
automations.rollback: Revoke/rotate exposed credentials and purge offending changes.
automations.abort: Abort on verified secret findings.

automations.name: GitHub Design System Guard
automations.gate: Prevents truncated or duplicated design-system stylesheet state.
automations.healthcheck: Line-count and marker verification for apps/website/app/globals.css
automations.rollback: Restore previous correct globals.css and rerun guard.
automations.abort: Abort on missing file, missing marker or unexpected truncation.

automations.name: GitLab Redundancy Pipeline
automations.gate: Backup CI/CD path for lint, test, build and manual deploy.
automations.healthcheck: GitLab runner completion and manual deploy readiness.
automations.rollback: Disable failing stage or use GitHub primary path until repaired.
automations.abort: Abort on runner, auth or critical stage failures.

automations.name: Resend Inbound Webhook Intake
automations.gate: Only accepts supported inbound email events and ignores internal senders.
automations.healthcheck: Webhook response status + downstream ticket creation / logging.
automations.rollback: Disable webhook route or revert inbound processing changes.
automations.abort: Abort on invalid payload, missing sender data or downstream persistence failure.

automations.name: Email Worker Polling
automations.gate: Runs only when IMAP credentials are configured; serialised manual polling is lock-protected.
automations.healthcheck: Worker state, last poll timestamp, processed/error counters.
automations.rollback: Disable IMAP worker via config and process mail manually until restored.
automations.abort: Abort or skip when credentials are missing, lock is held, or repeated poll failures occur.

automations.name: Agent Follow-up Task Scheduler
automations.gate: Only stores structured future tasks with run_at, title and closed instruction context.
automations.healthcheck: Task persistence in nexify_agent_tasks and downstream runner visibility.
automations.evidence: Database task records and agent action history
automations.rollback: Cancel pending tasks or revert task-creation changes.
automations.abort: Abort on invalid datetime, persistence errors or missing instruction fields.

automations.name: VPS Service Health Check
automations.gate: Operational verification for internal, external and webhook endpoints.
automations.healthcheck: Script exit code and endpoint reachability summary.
automations.rollback: Use deploy rollback path or restore failed service containers.
automations.abort: Abort on failed required endpoints or missing container runtime state.

automations.name: Weekly Governance Monitoring
automations.gate: Keeps the existing weekly governance schedule alive as mandatory baseline.
automations.healthcheck: Successful scheduled workflow run.
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions schedule history and audit reports
automations.rollback: Restore previous workflow schedule or run governance backfill manually.
automations.abort: Abort and escalate on repeated schedule failures or invalid workflow configuration.

automations.name: Daily Health Review
automations.gate: Planned daily review of infrastructure and service health.
automations.healthcheck: Daily execution log with pass/fail summary.
automations.rollback: Disable scheduled review and fall back to manual post-deploy checks.
automations.abort: Abort when the health review environment cannot reach required services.

automations.name: Secret and Dependency Review
automations.gate: Scheduled control for secret, dependency and drift findings.
automations.executor: Secret-scan/dependency tooling to be bound to the register and runbook
automations.healthcheck: Daily finding report or explicit zero-findings output.
automations.rollback: Disable the scheduled control and use manual backfill while repairing it.
automations.abort: Abort on verified secret hit or broken scanning substrate.

automations.name: Evidence Sync Check
automations.gate: Verifies that mandatory evidence artifacts exist for critical automations.
automations.executor: Governance audit routine to be defined from the operating model
automations.healthcheck: Evidence completeness report.
automations.rollback: Use manual governance audit until the check is restored.
automations.abort: Abort and escalate when critical evidence paths are missing.

automations.name: Stale Task Cleanup
automations.gate: Scheduled hygiene for expired or stalled runtime tasks.
automations.healthcheck: Cleanup summary with stale, cancelled and failed counts.
automations.rollback: Pause cleanup and restore tasks from audit trail if required.
automations.abort: Abort when task state cannot be read consistently.

automations.name: Backup and Restore Verification
automations.gate: Periodic proof that backup and recovery paths remain usable.
automations.executor: Production backup/restore runbook and verification scripts
automations.healthcheck: Successful verification report.
automations.rollback: Suspend automatic verification and use supervised manual DR test.
automations.abort: Abort on failed restore validation or missing backup artifacts.

automations.name: GitHub Self-Hosted Runner (VPS)
automations.gate: Runner-Token via GITHUB_PAT live abgeholt; /etc/nexifyai/secrets.env chmod 600; Docker-Socket-Mount.
automations.executor: Docker-Container nexify-github-runner (Dockerfile.github-runner); entrypoint.sh registriert und startet Runner.
automations.healthcheck: docker ps nexify-github-runner Status=Up; GitHub API /repos/.../actions/runners Total > 0.
automations.rollback: SSH-Fallback in deploy-vps.yml aktivieren; docker compose restart github-runner.
automations.abort: Abort wenn GITHUB_PAT fehlt oder abgelaufen; docker compose stop github-runner.

automations.name: VPS Worker Workflow — Proaktive Flows
automations.gate: Läuft nur auf self-hosted Runner (labels: vps, nexifyai); Jobs unabhängig (continue-on-error).
automations.executor: .github/workflows/vps-worker.yml auf Self-Hosted Runner; direkte Docker- und curl-Aufrufe.
automations.healthcheck: Job-Status in GitHub Actions; VPS_HEALTH_*.md Evidence; §11 Monitoring.
automations.rollback: workflow_dispatch job=quick-ping; Runner-Neustart.
automations.abort: Abort wenn Runner offline; Jobs haben Timeout 5–30 min.

automations.name: Deploy VPS (Self-Hosted Runner primär)
automations.gate: Self-Hosted Runner auf VPS; docker compose direkt; Health-Gate Website:3000 hartes Gate.
automations.executor: .github/workflows/deploy-vps.yml Job deploy-self-hosted; git reset --hard + docker compose pull + up.
automations.healthcheck: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health; docker compose ps nach Deploy.
automations.evidence: GitHub Actions Run-Log; §11 Governance-Post-Check in Workflow.
automations.rollback: git reset --hard <prev-sha>; docker compose up -d; SSH-Fallback-Job aktivieren.
automations.abort: Abort wenn Website-Health nach 5 Retry fehlschlägt.

automations.name: Harness Open Source — Git-Hosting & CI/CD Runtime
automations.gate: Harness OSS läuft als Docker-Container; PostgreSQL-Backend; TLS via Traefik; Cloudflare-Tunnel für externen Zugang.
automations.healthcheck: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/v1/system/health; docker compose ps harness harness-db.
automations.rollback: docker compose restart harness; DB-Dump aus /var/backup/ einspielen wenn nötig.
automations.abort: Abort wenn DB nicht healthy; Container stoppen mit docker compose stop harness.

automations.name: Harness CI — Redundanter CI-Pfad für Repo
automations.gate: Pipeline-YAML in .harness/ definiert; Stages: frontend-lint, frontend-test, design-system-guard, backend-lint, secret-scan, docker-build-check.
automations.executor: .harness/ci-default.yml auf Harness OSS Runner; containerisierte Stages.
automations.healthcheck: Pipeline-Status im Harness Web UI; /api/v1/system/health.
automations.rollback: Pipeline-Run stoppen im Harness UI; GitHub Actions bleibt primärer CI-Pfad.
automations.abort: Abort wenn Harness Container offline oder DB nicht erreichbar.
